scope: Local implementation verification for the reusable read-only release smoke runner; this does not certify the deployed website

checks.environment: normal user execution; sandbox temporary-cache rename had failed before any tests on the initial attempt

networkFailureRepair.firstCandidateAttempt: Uncaught browser route.fetch TLS connection failure; no success proof was produced.
networkFailureRepair.repair: Contain the entire asynchronous route handler, redact and record the failure before aborting the request. Exact-origin read-only route.fetch uses maxRedirects 0 and one ECONNRESET-only retry. HTTP/authentication or factual failures are not retried or hidden.
networkFailureRepair.candidateV2: A separate complete website run is owned by the native release adapter; its immutable proof is the deployment result.

unusedEarlierSnapshot: smoke/expected-data is an earlier root-byte snapshot retained for audit. The actual expected-input reads the frozen candidate content/data so that all six raw data hashes match the source plan exactly.
